Dead continent theory is a belief held by certain polytheists today. It essentially holds that in the Americas and Australia the gods of nature are effectively unreachable to the majorities of the populations there, being only accessible by indigenous groups. 

It is unclear how many people believe in this notion. But it can effectively make animistic or pantheistic practice impossible for a very large number of people.

== Solutions ==
There are numerous possible solutions to this situations

# Challenging the right of indigenous groups to be closed in some way
## this does not necessarily imply  a full rejection of their right to be closed
## say they can be closed for Amatsukami like Quetzalcoatl but not deities with direct physical correlates
## Ability to worship land gods may be seen as necessary for human flourishing, and as such denying anyone the ability would be unethical trumping ideas of cultural continuity
## Gods may be seen as independently wanting worship from their ujiko and as such attempting to keep them from their ujiko would be disrespectful to them
# Arguing indigenous practices don't actually hold this belief. As a non indigenous person I'm not in a good position to address this issue
# Finding land gods to worship outside of indigenous traditions by studying them to figure out which deities not to worship
## unclear if this can actually be done considering traditions may have been lost, not even due to colonialism but due to millennia of history
## Feels strange, this strange feeling needs further examination
# Finding land gods by a scheme independent of indigenous traditions
## agnostic to indigenous practices
## People may believe what they want, or they may be under strict control
## All names must be systematically derived independent of indigenous culture. Perhaps myths also systematically derived
# Bringing European land gods over
## paradoxically colonial, especially if you believe in gods being bound to earth then it can effectively mean forcibly changing the names and myths of gods[[Category:Oldest pages before the refresh]]
